## GOOGLE ADS REPORTING INGEST
Disabled source-controlled template. Accept only the aggregate payload from the read-only Google Ads Script installed in customer **932-938-7049**. Configure Header Auth for `X-FB-Ads-Sync-Key`, connect the existing Supabase service-role credential, validate one completed-day sample twice, and obtain approval before opening the gate or activating the webhook. No live webhook URL or secret belongs in source control.
